svg.title: Three People Launch; Five People Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-three-to-five-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Three People Launch; Five People Scale; subtitle: Clear ownership separates filing execution from cash reconciliation.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Canonical Conservative: $110,000 revenue × 30% = $33,000 owner profit with 1 FT + 2 C. Canonical Base-Case: $505,000 × 43.0% = $217,150 with the same three-person structure. Canonical Scaled: $900,000 × 56% = $504,000 with 2 FT + 3 C. Revenue means earned operator contingency, not provider collections. Seats four and five are additions only in the Scaled configuration.; caption: FT means full-time seat; C means contractor seat, not assumed full-time capacity. Assign a named backup for every deadline and keep evidence decisions separate from receipt confirmation.; stages: label: Owner and recovery lead; value: Launch: 1 FT; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own provider contracts, jurisdiction exceptions, offer authority, fee-base definitions, and operating economics. Maintain the exception queue and engage appropriately qualified specialists when a matter exceeds the team's authorized scope.; label: Claims and deadline analyst; value: Launch: 1 C; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Parse 835 records, verify initial remittances, maintain business-day calendars, preserve negotiation delivery evidence, and prepare eligible batches. Escalate missing plan documentation before filing costs are committed.; label: Clinical evidence specialist; value: Launch: 1 C; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Connect chart-supported acuity and complexity to permitted offer factors, redact unnecessary information, and inspect licensed data extracts for prohibited benchmarks. The owner checks submission authority and final packet quality.; label: Operations and collections lead; value: Scale addition: 1 FT; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Take ownership of capacity planning, payer payment follow-up, determination-date tracking, and cash reconciliation. Monitor the applicable 30-calendar-day payment obligation after determination separately from actual collection performance.; label: Remittance quality specialist; value: Scale addition: 1 C; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Independently match bank receipts, corrected remittances, entity refunds, and provider allocations. Sample earned contingency calculations for duplicate collections, baseline-payment leakage, and double-counted case costs.
